name: arms-substitution-example-v1
description: Illustrative rubric for an `instar arms` comparison: can a cheaper model replace the baseline? Binds only arm.* metrics, so it can be applied to stored runs with `instar corpus rubric`. These thresholds are an EXAMPLE of the format, not a recommendation; agree your own with whoever owns the outcome, before the run.

dimensions.label: Quality relative to the same-model control
dimensions.rationale: Read against the control, not as a raw score: the control's score is the judge's own error. Below 0.85 users would notice.

dimensions.label: No answer judged a failure
dimensions.rationale: A healthy mean can hide one feature the cheaper model cannot do at all.

dimensions.label: Cost saved vs the baseline arm
dimensions.rationale: Below 20% the switch isn't worth the operational cost of a second model.

dimensions.label: p95 latency
dimensions.rationale: Generous: most of these calls are background work. Tighten for anything a person watches.

dimensions.label: No failed calls
dimensions.rationale: Failed calls are excluded from every other number. Fix the run before reading the verdict.
